key.name: toggle-osk
key.summary: Show or hide the on-screen keyboard
key.description: Accelerator sent by the Toughbook CF-19 keyboard button (tablet button 1).

key.name: security
key.description: Accelerator sent by the Toughbook CF-19 security button (tablet button 4), the Ctrl-Alt-Del equivalent.

key.name: rotate
key.description: Accelerator sent by the Toughbook CF-19 rotation button (tablet button 3). Handled by the extension so it also works while a dialog or menu is open.
